title: Read 3D camera and board Z range, set body opacity
summary: Shows how to read and write the camera of a board's main graphical view, read the board's Z range and an entry of its exported parameter string, and change the 3D opacity of a component body inside a modify bracket.
phrasings: make a component body transparent in 3D
get or set the 3D view camera of a PCB
read the board thickness range in Z
read a value from a board's exported parameters

commands.name: BoardInfo3D
commands.description: Report the board Z range, the 3D camera and ROUTETOOLPATHLAYER

commands.name: SetCamera
commands.description: Set the 3D camera of the main view (default: current camera)

commands.name: SetBodyOpacity
commands.description: Set the 3D opacity of the first component body
